name: Color cycling
description: Six cozy pixel-art scenes, a waterfall at dusk, a harbor at sunset, a rainy village, a snowy cabin, the northern lights and a campfire, animated only by cycling their palettes: each is drawn once, a byte a cell, and then only the colors move, so even an ESP32 animates them smoothly. A footer has Previous and Next, the scene's name, the frame rate and Hide; a tap or a swipe is the next scene too.
